standard_references.evidence: Supplied official-source excerpt shows SDMX Glossary entries including Metadata Structure Definition, Metadata Set, Metadata update, and a cross-domain concept entry for Geographical coverage with Concept ID COVERAGE_GEO and recommended representation String; Codelist.

Supplied official-source excerpt shows the SDMX Global Registry interface includes Codelists and Metadata / Metadata Structures among searchable artefact categories; it does not confirm any specific health-domain codelist or metadata concept scheme version for this report.

The guideline URL is supplied in the principles as a recommended source for SDMX reference metadata concepts, but no fetched external excerpt confirming exact concept IDs, definitions and versions from that guideline was supplied in the evidence package.

Supplied official-source excerpt shows UN M49 country and area entries with numeric and alpha codes. The report areas Northland, Centralia and South Coast are synthetic/local area labels and are not confirmed as UN M49 areas from the supplied excerpt.

limitations: No report contact details are stated, so CONTACT is not populated as a metadata value.
No source URL or persistent report URL is stated in the supplied report context, so SOURCE_URL is not populated as a metadata value.
No metadata update date is stated separately from the publication date, so META_UPDATE is not populated as a metadata value.
No legal or institutional mandate is stated in the report.

Exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme IDs and versions are not confirmed from supplied external evidence for most metadata concepts; candidate/local concept IDs from the accepted MSD are used without asserting confirmed standard reuse.
The report states that cause labels resemble broad ICD families but no ICD version is confirmed; no ICD version is asserted in these metadata values.
The geographic area labels Northland, Centralia and South Coast are synthetic/local labels and are not mapped to UN M49 or ISO 3166.
Target dataflow identifiers are practical local identifiers for this extraction because no accepted DATAFLOW artifact was supplied in the prompt.
